about: What lag serve and its clients (the console, lag goals, the phone app) agree on. docs/api-contract.md explains it in words. Types are JSON types; 'a|b' means either. Clients ignore event types and fields they do not know, so the server may add both without a new contract version. Removing, renaming or retyping anything listed here needs contract 2.

start.about: A run begins. stages: [{name, model}] in run order; loads: cold model loads it will cost.

stage.about: A stage starts talking. loaded: true when its model had to be loaded cold. role: lead | stage.

thinking.about: A piece of the model's reasoning. Show it collapsed.

token.about: A piece of the answer, already cleaned for display.

tool.about: The model called a tool. pretty is the call as a person should read it.

tool_result.about: What the tool returned, cleaned and cut to 2,000 characters.

routing.about: The orchestrator is choosing agents. candidates: agent names.

routed.about: The orchestrator chose. agents: [{name, model}] in run order.

route_fallback.about: The orchestrator's choice could not be read; the default roster runs instead. agents: names.

trimmed.about: Earlier work was cut from the middle to fit this stage's budget.

no_tools.about: The model cannot call tools, so this turn runs without them.

turn_error.about: One model turn failed and is being retried. Three in a row end the run.

final_answer_nudge.about: Tool turns ran out; the model is asked to answer without tools.

shared_model.about: A goal is running, so this chat uses the goal's model to avoid a reload.

nudge.about: A goal's last stage stopped to ask; it is sent back to decide for itself.

check.about: The done-when check. verdict: met | not met | unchecked.

error.about: The run failed. The last event of its stream.

done.about: The run finished. answer: the final answer, when there is one.

goals.about: The whole goal queue. goals: see goal_record. settings: {plan, fail, model}.

cycle_error.about: Agent mode: a cycle failed; the loop backs off and continues.

agent_done.about: Agent mode: the agent marked its goal done.

agent_stop.about: Agent mode: the loop stopped. reason: busy | no_sandbox | max_cycles | stop_requested | failed_cycles | no_progress.

agent_end.about: Agent mode: the last event of a run.

goal_event.about: On /api/goals/events, every event of the running goal carries one extra field naming it.

goal_record.about: One goal, as it appears in a goals snapshot.

errors.about: Every failure carries an error string. Check for it whatever the status: refused requests answer 4xx, but /api/run and goal edits answer 200 with error (plus the snapshot), and a stream's failure is its last event, type error.

GET /api/goals/events.response: stream: goals events, plus the running goal's events with goal_event fields

phone_port.about: lag serve --phone-port. Every request needs 'Authorization: Bearer <device key>' except POST /api/pair. 401: no key, or not paired / revoked. 403: the key belongs to another Tailscale user, or a cross-site request.
